fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on a labor dispute involving movie theater operators and stage hands and the response by theater owners and police; criticism of Miami’s licensing enforcement in an arrest connected to a theater production; discussion of Florida election and judicial appointment practices; coverage of Republican Party infighting in Florida; reports and commentary on prohibition enforcement, bootlegging, rum-running, and informants; civic pieces on downtown parking behavior and support for local businesses versus seasonal outsiders; Coral Gables municipal politics and transportation administration; notes on dry cleaning price disputes; and assorted humor, gossip/columns, advertisements, and entertainment listings.
